questions.question: How should the app handle a stray ?as= on a non-dev-login route (dev/local only)?

options.label: Auto-redirect through dev-login
options.description: A dev-only middleware spots ?as= on any normal route and 302-redirects through /dev-login/<same-path>, so impersonation always takes effect. Most convenient — the URL you typed just works. Slightly 'magic'; needs to preserve the rest of the query string.

options.label: Hard error with a hint
options.description: Dev-only: ?as= on a non-dev-login route aborts 400 with 'Did you mean /dev-login/accounts?as=account:7?'. Explicit and safe; teaches the correct URL but doesn't do it for you.

options.label: Warning banner only
options.description: Render the page as normal (still the current user) but show a dev banner: '?as= ignored here — use /dev-login/...'. Non-disruptive nudge; you still see the 'wrong' data underneath.

options.label: Just document it
options.description: No code change; add a note to CLAUDE.md / the dev-login route comment clarifying ?as= only works on /dev-login.
